title: Exact full-energy Bregman identity for the critical shell channel

all_term_identity.functional: On the active optimized-mean branch J_g(s)=F(s)+6gA(s)(2c_C-A(s)), with A(s)=(1/2)int s/|x| and F(s)=(1/4)int |x|(s+s^(-1)-2).
all_term_identity.profile: The K1572 minimizer is s_*(x)=|x|/sqrt(|x|^2+kappa_g), with kappa_g=24g(c_C-A_*).
all_term_identity.bregman: J_g(s)-J_g(s_*)=(1/4)int |x|(s-s_*)^2/(s s_*^2)-6g(A(s)-A_*)^2 for every positive profile remaining on the active branch.
all_term_identity.shell_inflation: For s_rho=(1+rho)s_* on E and s_* off E, the exact difference is rho^2[W_E/(4(1+rho))-(3g/2)B_E^2], where W_E=int_E sqrt(|x|^2+kappa_g) and B_E=int_E 1/sqrt(|x|^2+kappa_g).
all_term_identity.scope_guard: This is the full leading coefficient identity for the stationary diagonal Gaussian shell output. It is not a global non-Gaussian or nonstationary coercivity theorem.
